name: University of Tsukuba
description: The University of Tsukuba is a national university in Tsukuba Science City, Ibaraki, established in 1973 from the former Tokyo University of Education. It teaches several undergraduate courses fully in English.
whyIncluded: The University of Tsukuba is among the 10 universities in Japan most chosen by international students (2,298 international students in May 2025 per JASSO), per the FinexisEdu shortlist research of October 2026.

livingCosts.summary: The University of Tsukuba's own figures: about 80,000 a month for food, clothing and study materials, split here into food, transport and personal, plus its 30,000-50,000 estimate for a private room in Tsukuba, 12 months a year.
livingCosts.notes: Rung B (university's own total, no breakdown). University of Tsukuba admissions 'Fees & Living Expenses' page (undated, read 2026-10-08): 'average living expenses including food, clothing and study materials are approximately 80,000 per month', excluding dormitory fees. Housing is from the university's 'Accommodation' page (tsukuba.ac.jp/en/students/campus-life/accommodation): off-campus 6-tatami room with kitchen, bath and toilet 30,000-50,000 per month, midpoint 40,000 (utilities not stated; the student residence fee schedule is in a linked PDF not read here). The 80,000 is split with the Japan average shares for the non-housing categories (food .30, transport .05, personal .15, renormalised to .60/.10/.30): food 48,000, transport 8,000, personal 24,000. The page lists no insurance figure, so National Health Insurance is not separately included; tuition excluded.

programmes.name: Interdisciplinary Engineering Program (English-taught)
programmes.summary: Standard national tuition for 2026 entrants. International students entering from April 2027 will pay a higher revised rate. The one-off ¥282,000 is the admission fee. Taught in English.
programmes.notes: English-taught programme listed on the university's English programmes site (all required classes taught in English). 'Admission & Tuition Fees' page: admission fee ¥282,000 and annual tuition ¥535,800 (¥267,900 per term, as of 1 April 2026) for undergraduate and graduate students. The page says tuition will be revised for international students enrolling on or after 1 April 2027; the detailed notice (PDF) could not be read (robots-blocked). Times Higher Education reports the new international rate as ¥608,800 a year (+¥73,000), unconfirmed on the university's own pages, so the 2026 rate is recorded and the calculator's yearly increase applies to later starts. National-university fees may be revised during enrolment, so not cohort-locked. No year-specific 2024/2025 figure read, so no history.
